findings.title: Pure audit omits action-side current image provenance checks
findings.repro: Run tests/goal-fragment-audit-independent.test.ts lines34-35; change action modelInput.observation.id or action assetFiles.current.sha256 only.
findings.expected: Expose action source divergence in consistency/issues.
findings.impact: Exported pure audit can report zero consistency issues while prepared action input points at a different observation/image. Normal replay wrapper performs stronger admission; actual saved run remains consistent.

findings.title: Equal memory copies bypass record/memory structural validity
findings.repro: Run independent tests lines36-39: alter current record kind/scope and copied entries together, memory schemaVersion99 in all copies, or prepend malformed carried entry to each copy.
findings.expected: Validate current and carried record kind/scope and memory schema independently of equality and surface malformed data.
findings.actual: All variants retain issues=[] and framesWithIssues=0; malformed scope is echoed as all-history.
findings.impact: The pure function equates identical copies with valid memory structure, allowing unsupported record meaning to look clean. Does not show corruption of the original live files.

findings.title: Invalid admitted whole-Goal status is silently accepted
findings.repro: Run independent test line40; set deliberation.assessment.goal=alien.
findings.expected: Keep raw and admitted fields separate, validate admitted status enum, and flag malformed admitted Goal without requiring equality to raw.
findings.impact: Unsupported admitted whole-Goal values are presented without a diagnostic in the pure audit. The real raw unsatisfied/admitted uncertain distinction is legitimate and retained.
